sec.title: August 26 Exhaustive Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 164)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the comprehensive provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, serial multi-part narrative arcs, and story synopses for historical broadcasts transmitting on **August 26** across American network, syndicated, and armed forces radio, Anne Nichols' classic *Abie's Irish Rose* for Drene Shampoo, Tennessee Ernie Ford on *The Ford Road Show*, Joe E. Brown and Mel Blanc entertaining troops on AFRS *G.I. Journal*, Don MacLaughlin on Salvation Army's *Heartbeat Theatre*, Jimmy Scribner's 22-voice tour de force on *The Johnson Family*, and *Betty and Bob* (1944–1958):
